title: R6R3 Runtime Handoff Authentication Rules R2

rules.requirement: Validate the candidate against R6R3_RUNTIME_HANDOFF_SCHEMA_R2 and require authenticated runtime status.
Recompute package_manifest hash after removing only its own manifest_sha256 member.

operator_applications.subject: run_identity.runtime_root, selected_inputs.runtime_root, package_manifest.runtime_root, all binding paths

rules.requirement: Require exactly the complete 20-ID set, one path per ID, one root, and no unselected required artifact.
Read only selected exact paths and authenticate stable regular-file objects.
Require an independently resolvable committed producer/source state with matching hashes; otherwise block.
Require one dedicated manifest-bound receipt. Producer compatibility is false until E0-A emits it.
All runtime artifacts and records must bind to the declared run and exact root.

operator_applications.subject: raw audit rows
operator_applications.expected: unique positive serials and recomputed hashes

rules.requirement: Authenticate raw JSONL bytes, serial uniqueness, decoded bytes, hashes, and record types.

operator_applications.subject: normalized event rows
operator_applications.expected: unique IDs/serials, eight classes, role, and recomputed hashes

rules.requirement: Authenticate normalized rows, event classes, raw serials, role, and decoded event bytes.

operator_applications.subject: r6_raw_audit and r6_normalized_events
operator_applications.expected: exact serial, bytes, and hash equality

rules.requirement: Recompute same-serial byte and hash equality; coverage flags cannot substitute.

operator_applications.subject: each FILE_READ_OR_WRITE event and its raw serial bundle

rules.requirement: Require same-serial successful supported syscall, exact audit key, and exact watched path.

operator_applications.subject: normalized process-bearing rows and r6_pid_netns_join
operator_applications.expected: one JOINED row per six-field role-bearing key

rules.requirement: Join by exact six-field role-bearing key with exactly one candidate and namespace assertions.

operator_applications.subject: normalized event rows and r6_coverage_and_loss
operator_applications.expected: exact ordered eight-class counts and zero loss

rules.requirement: Recompute the exact eight-class closure and require zero loss/backlog/duplicates.

operator_applications.subject: r6_pcap, pcap_authentication, coverage, post_cleanup
operator_applications.expected: one exact binary hash across all sources

rules.requirement: Authenticate exact PCAP bytes against all required hash sources; provenance only.

operator_applications.subject: cleanup pre-state, journal, transient contract, residual, post-cleanup

rules.requirement: Recompute cleanup from pre-state, journal, transient contract, residual evidence, and post-cleanup revalidation.

operator_applications.subject: handoff.hard_boundaries
operator_applications.expected: all forbidden-operation flags false and PCAP graph-source false

rules.requirement: Adapter and frozen encoder remain unchanged; no detector, inference, Mininet, privileged commands, formal evaluation, or fabricated runtime data.

operator_applications.subject: handoff and all selected artifact objects
operator_applications.expected: unchanged canonical bytes, identities, hashes, and zero rule failures

rules.requirement: Revalidate all selected inputs and canonical hashes after all reads.
